tattoo-balm.name: Tattoo Balm
tattoo-balm.description: Balm for freshly tattooed skin, made with natural ingredients: shea butter, mango butter, aloe vera, vitamin E, rosehip oil and more. Moisturizing, with fast absorption and good adherence to the skin. Vegan, paraben-free, petrolatum-free, no dyes. Exclusive fragrance. 25 g.

Moisturizing, fast absorption
Vegan, paraben-free, petrolatum-free, no dyes
Good adherence to the skin

content.usage_instructions:
Wash your hands and apply a thin layer over the tattoo.
Use it 2 to 3 times a day for 14 days.
Follow your tattooer's aftercare advice.

slimer-gel.name: Slimer Tattoo Gel
slimer-gel.description: The water-based gel to keep within reach all session long. Use it as your glide instead of vaseline or butter, wipe away excess ink mid-session, and leave a layer on finished areas while you work on the rest. At the end it gives a fresh, clean shine, which is why our pro team uses it for post-tattoo photos. Light texture, mint essence and plant extracts. Moisturizing and non-drying. Apply it with a spatula.
features: Glides all session long, instead of vaseline or butter
Wipes away excess ink mid-session
Leave a layer on finished areas while you keep working
Fresh, clean shine: the pro team's go-to for post-tattoo photos

content.usage_instructions:
Once the stencil is on and fixed, spread the gel with a spatula and use it as your glide.
Mid-session, use it to wipe away excess ink. On areas you've finished, leave a layer on while you work on the rest.
At the end, a final layer gives a fresh, clean shine for photos. Reapply whenever needed.

gloo-stencil.name: The Gloo Stencil Transfer

Fast drying

transfer-it.name: Transfer It
transfer-it.description: Stencil transfer cream with extra hold, for sharp, well-defined stencils that last through long sessions. Works with thermal and hand-drawn stencils. The moisturizing formula helps keep the skin from drying out and goes a long way. Once dry, a stencil applied with IT stays put: only IT itself takes it off.
features: Extra hold for long sessions

Moisturizing formula, high yield

content.usage_instructions:
Apply a thin layer on clean, dry skin and spread until a transparent film forms.
Place the stencil and press firmly for about 10 seconds.
If the stencil is misplaced, rub a little IT over it before it dries and wipe it off.
Let it dry completely before you start.

A breathable, waterproof second skin that adapts to the skin without wrinkles. Cut it to size, stick it over the tattoo and leave it on for up to 4 days. Hypoallergenic and comfortable.

content.usage_instructions:
Apply After All and make sure the skin is fully dry and free of residue.
Wear disposable gloves. Cut the film to size, leaving a safety margin around the tattoo.
Press it gently onto the skin so it sticks without wrinkles.
